## What it is

Number 4, rendered orange. Back-right, 45°. Recessed 4. Three openings: 40, 66 and 92 mm. Not the start of the coil.

## Design notes

- Print it on its side, flat face down. The C opens outward. Between clips the spine widens to 11 mm.
- The foot is a 4 × 8 mm tab. The top has a straight notch for the disc. The recessed 4 is the only mark.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't print it standing up.
- Don't put it on slot 1, 2, or 3. The tab will fit, and the openings will be on the wrong heights.
